plain: In a demanding way that allows no refusal

webster.text: Absolutely; positively; in a decisive manner; so as to preclude further debate.

example.quote: The debts due the British are also very considerable ; these dtbts have been withheld contrary to treaty: if Great Britain will demand the payment of these debts peremptorily, what will be the consequence ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
